name: Should I handle interior finishing myself or hire a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: Should I handle interior finishing myself or hire a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: For simple tasks like painting a single room, DIY might be feasible. However, for comprehensive interior finishing projects involving multiple trades, complex installations (e.g., custom cabinetry, intricate tile work), or structural changes, hiring a general contractor is highly recommended. A contractor manages scheduling, coordinates specialized subcontractors, ensures quality control, handles permits, and oversees the entire project to completion. This saves you time, stress, and often money in the long run by avoiding costly mistakes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a general contractor for complex interior finishing projects involving multiple trades, installations, or structural work to ensure proper management and quality.
